# Pull Request

## What

<!-- One or two sentences: what changed and why. -->

## Type

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change
- [ ] `perf` — faster or less memory
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` — tooling
- [ ] `chore` — dependency or housekeeping

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` has no errors
- [ ] `npm run build` was run and `dist/` is committed (it is tracked)
- [ ] `README.md` / `ARCHITECTURE.md` / `SPEC.md` updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or `.env` content in the diff

## How was this tested?

<!-- Commands you ran, or what you clicked through in `npm run dev`. -->

## Notes for the reviewer

<!-- Anything subtle, a trade-off you made, or a question you want answered. -->
